verdict.rationale: Pipedrive's own docs say it tracks the sales pipeline and moves deals through it, and a community user compares its ease of use to Trello, which suggests a visual board. However, no evidence explicitly documents a visual pipeline view, customizable stages, or drag-and-drop updates. missing for 10: documented visual/kanban pipeline view, customizable stage configuration, drag-and-drop deal movement, hands-on corroboration of these.

support.subject: As a founder, I can track deals on a visual pipeline with customizable stages and drag-and-drop updates

citations.quote: Pipedrive lets you track your sales pipeline
it merges the functionality of CRM with the ease of use of Trello.
